dom.scene: A covered bicycle shelter after a summer rain, gray daylight reflecting from wet pavement. Squatting beside her commuter bicycle, she reseats a slipped chain with a small cloth while the other hand supports the frame; natural separated hands. Face looks up at the camera with a mildly annoyed expression. No branded bicycle text.
dom.outfit: A cobalt sleeveless zip-front athletic crop vest, white running shorts, practical sneakers and a loosely tied rain shell at the waist, a tiny spiral zipper charm. Bare arms, midriff and thighs; personal cycling outfit, no armor or mechanical attachments.
